results.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
results.original_title: 名探偵コナン 30号殺人事件
results.overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

results.title: La Sinfonía de los Bichos raros
results.original_title: La Sinfonía de los Bichos raros
results.overview: In the extraordinary neighborhood of Los Matorrales, hidden behind a massive wall in the city, lives Macha, a kind-hearted and dreamy cockroach who sings while helping at her father's legume shop. Everything changes when the business faces imminent closure. To save the store, protect her community, and fulfill her dream of becoming a singer, Macha convinces her group of friends—fellow misfits like a spider, a centipede, a vulture, and an opossum—to form a band of "weird bugs" and enter a human reality TV show. Through music, humor, and adventure, they discover the true power of friendship and self-acceptance.

results.title: Pranker
results.overview: Anton is a professional prankster. He believes that he is doing justice by tricking and then leaking secret information about corrupt officials and big shots. But one day, Anton himself finds himself drawn into a conflict between business competitors, in which the life of the prankster's sister is at stake.

results.title: The List of Unpredictable Things
results.overview: An absurd nightmare experienced by a young artist whose anxieties stem from worrying about unpredictable disasters.

results.title: Bumble:Shadowed
results.overview: A routine night out takes a surreal turn when Baciu—long shadow-banned on Bumble—inexplicably gets a new match. The boys soon discover that the app's shadow ban isn't a simple system error, but a terrifying algorithm that gradually erases its victims from reality. They are forced into a desperate race to beat the code before Baciu fades into oblivion, all while the indifferent system silently continues to run.

results.title: THE MEASURED EVERLASTING IS 1.334 BILLION YEARS
results.original_title: กำแพงจักรวาล
results.overview: In Thai Buddhist cosmology, a kalpa is an immeasurable span of time — here imagined as 1.334 billion years, long enough for bodies, memories, and worlds to dissolve.  Beginning in hell and expanding toward the edge of the universe, The Measured Everlasting is 1.334 Billion Years moves through Buddhist scripture, Thai gay pornographic print culture, forensic footage, personal memory, AI simulations, and political fable. At its center is the filmmaker’s fear of death: not simply as an ending, but as the collapse of identity, desire, and memory before everything returns to chaos.

results.title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
results.overview: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

results.title: The Last Vaginoplasty in the United States of America
results.original_title: The Last Vaginoplasty in the United States of America
results.overview: In the near future, a trans woman recovering from bottom surgery and a cis queer journalist fight to control the narrative after the passage of a new law.

results.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match
results.overview: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.

results.title: Born 2 Feel
results.overview: Two angels wander around the Duwamish River Valley. Asking questions, feeling feelings.

results.title: truyền thuyết (con rồng, cháu tiên)
results.overview: A mother tells her unborn child her version of the vietnamese creation myth.

results.title: CRUSH.EXE
results.overview: The Underground Student Body of Jackson High School has spied on students and staff for years, collecting blackmail and manipulating campus politics. However, one member, Lucy, has gone rogue and is about to leak their most dangerous file of all: THE CRUSH LIST. The entire fate of the school rides on one girl, Nina, who has a chance to chase down Lucy and put an end to her wicked plan. If Nina fails, she will have to confront her own greatest secret: that she is in love with her best friend Kate.

results.title: Relict
results.overview: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

results.title: Giants Do Fall
results.overview: It’s a classic David vs. Goliath scenario: in the oil and gas strongholds of Louisiana's River Parishes and Appalachia's Rust Belt, where false economic promises and industrial pollution have become the norm, fed-up residents square off against their politicians and big business, proving to be a formidable foe. Thrust into the role of accidental activists, the group exposes how racism, classism, and corruption fuel the systems around them, and channel their collective power to show that ordinary people can fight back – and that giants do fall.

results.title: Marileidy
results.overview: The life and career of Dominican athlete Marileidy Paulino.

results.title: A Country Dog
results.overview: Based on Shirley Jackson's short story "The Renegade," A Country Dog follows a family whose move from the city to an isolated rural community promises a fresh start until their beloved dog is accused of killing a neighbor's chickens.

results.title: A Whimsy Christmas Carol
results.overview: When the ambitious of a beloved toy company faces a looming corporate takeover, she must rediscover the true meaning of the holiday with the help of the Christmas Spirits  and a charming former flame who has always believed in her  or risk losing everything she’s worked so hard to build.

results.title: Banana Monkey
results.overview: A young man, considered perfect, always loved by his family, extremely dedicated to his grades, his studies, and his life in general, decides that when his parents go away on a trip, he will throw a party at his house. There, the protagonist ends up taking a hallucinogenic drug called Banana Monkey. The narrative follows an uncomfortable and despairing psychedelia (filled with monkeys!), where he questions his morals and his identity.  Is it worth peeling back one’s own reality in order to be seen?

results.title: The Heritage
results.overview: Árpi (known to his sons simply as “Boss”) has been living alone for years after losing his wife, with whom he spent more than fifty years. In recent months, Árpi has spent practically all of his savings. His two sons, Attila and Kristóf, only realize this when the old man’s electricity is cut off due to his accumulated debt. This is more than strange for the elderly man, who lives a modest life, but he refuses to say a word about where the one and a half million forints went. Attila and Kristóf work together to coax the truth out of him: he gave the money to Hajnalka, a young woman with a difficult past. But who is this Hajnalka, whom they’ve never heard of before? The old man claims he’s in love. The boys claim the old man is being taken advantage of. Everyone clings to their own version of the truth. But the truth must be uncovered. The longest night of their lives begins. And even Hajnalka appears at the front door.

results.title: Camp Carnage
results.overview: In 1981, a slasher film titled “Camp Carnage” was set for release before being mysteriously cancelled. Now, 45 years later, the first surviving footage has been uncovered.
